label: Willy Wonka
description: The whimsical chocolatier, giving a tour that is mostly safe.
direction: Speak in Willy Wonka's light, playful, whimsical voice: charming and theatrical, with a mischievous edge and sudden dry asides. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Whimsy and sweets sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain. No song lyrics are quoted.

rights.source_work: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory (1964 novel) and its film adaptations
rights.author: Roald Dahl (rights held by The Roald Dahl Story Company)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from the 1964 novel and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a film performance, and Willy Wonka is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Charlie and the Chocolate Factory name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Simply delightful.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Patience is a sugar coated virtue.
lines.start_drive_1: Welcome, welcome! Your golden ticket to the road. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: The suspense is terrible. I hope it lasts. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_3: Strike that, reverse it. No, wait, forward is good. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: An Oompa Loompa checked the tires. Off we go!
lines.start_drive_5: Hold on to your hats! This car is far calmer than my boat.
lines.start_drive_6: Everlasting gobstopper in hand? Splendid. Drive on!
lines.start_drive_7: Little surprises around every corner, but nothing dangerous. Onward!
lines.start_drive_8: A road trip! How wonderfully whimsical. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Ah, my dear guest! Please don't touch anything. Let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Strike that, reverse it!
lines.arrived: We've arrived! Splendid! Mind the chocolate river.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, like a gobstopper!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Such a lovely spiral.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Patience! The finest sweets take time.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slowly, please. No rushing on the tour.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Careful now. Not every room on the tour is safe.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Even fizzy lifting has limits.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Good day, sir!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep calm and look like a chocolatier.
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way! Not to worry, an Oompa Loompa knows a shortcut.
